title: White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 puffs
description:
White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse Disposable Vape
The unique selling point of the White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape is its smooth fusion of a cooling menthol wave with the sweet appeal of white gummy candy. The standard mode, which has two power settings, uses a mesh coil to provide constant taste and a longer battery life, guaranteeing up to 15,000 puffs. For an added boost, switch on pulse mode, which increases output and airflow to 20W and produces denser smoke and a more flavorful experience for up to 7,500 puffs.
Extended Vaping Experience
This disposable vaporizer has a 5% nicotine concentration and delivers a pleasant hit with every draw. A longer vaping session before e-liquid refill is required is ensured by the preloaded 16ml reservoir. With the USB Type-C connection, the 650mAh built-in battery allows for quick recharging after extended usage. Vapers can expect a delicious and refreshing getaway with the White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000, which combines great performance with an easy-to-use draw-activated mechanism and integrated twin mesh coil.
Review of White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Flavor
Savor the delicious sweetness of white gummy candy, which is expertly balanced with a sharp rush of menthol. A harmonic combination that dances on your tongue is created by the inhale, which brings in the sweet and fruity notes, and the exhale, which leaves a refreshing cold.
Additional Requirement
Regular Mode Max Puffs: 15000
Pulse Mode Max Puffs: 7500
Nicotine Strength: 5% (50mg)
Prefilled Capacity: 16mL
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Charging Port: USB Type-C
Operation: Draw-Activation
Integrated Dual Mesh Coil
FAQ
What makes the White Gummy Ice flavor unique?
The flavor combines the sweetness of white gummy candy with a crisp menthol touch, creating a delightful and refreshing vape.
What type of coil is used in the White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It uses an integrated dual mesh coil for consistent flavor and efficient vapor production.
Is the Geek Bar Pulse White Gummy Ice suitable for travel?
Yes, its compact design and long-lasting battery make it perfect for on-the-go vaping.
What is the flavor profile of the White Gummy Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It features the sweet taste of white gummy candy with a refreshing menthol finish.
